messages:
Alice Park: kicking off a quick thread on the sidebar/quicklinks reorg i sketched this AM. thinking: group by task (Deploy, Models, Observability, Accounts) not by product area. also add a small persistent Quicklinks strip at top for deep links and a breadcrumb that mirrors URL. :sparkles:
Ben H.: i like task grouping. fewer clicks for common flows. question: do we keep existing top-level icons or collapse into a single 'Workspace' root?
Carla M.: accessibility nits: if we change grouping we need clear aria-labels on group headers, and ensure focus order matches visual order. keyboard-only users should get a predictable tab stop into the quicklinks strip. :a11y:
Dmitri S.: routing concerns: deep links -> we need a stable URL schema. proposal: /workspace/:orgId/(deploy|models|obs|account)/:subpath. bookmarkable, and breadcrumb derives from path segments. fallback: hash fragments for legacy routes.
Emma L.: copy tweak: rename "Observability" to "Metrics & Traces" in the nav? it's clearer for product folks. also Quicklinks label maybe "Shortcuts" (shorter).
Alice Park: good call on copy. i prefer "Shortcuts" too. Dmitri, can we support both path + hash fallback without performance hit?
Dmitri S.: yes — router reads `window.location.pathname` first, if not recognized check `location.hash`. pseudo: ```js
// router init
const route = parsePath(location.pathname) || parseHash(location.hash) || defaultRoute;
navigate(route);
```
Ben H.: for grouping visuals: mockup suggestion: compact groups with subtle separators, collapse state saved per-user (localStorage). would reduce noise.
Carla M.: also ensure breadcrumbs use `aria-current=\"page\"` for the active crumb and each crumb is a real link. for collapsed groups the toggle should be `button` with `aria-expanded` state.
Alice Park: decision needed: 1) adopt task-based grouping, 2) add Shortcuts strip, 3) implement path-first routing with hash fallback, 4) copy updates (Observability -> Metrics & Traces). thumbs?
Ben H.: 👍 from me.
Carla M.: +1, but I'll add an accessibility checklist before dev handoff.
Dmitri S.: +1. will draft routing PR with examples and backwards compat.
Emma L.: +1. i'll update the UI copy strings in figma and add the short label variants.
nav-bot: Created ticket REDINF-4321: "Quicklinks reorg + path/hash routing + breadcrumb accessibility" assigned to @Dmitri S., @Carla M., @Emma L. link: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/REDINF-4321
Alice Park: sweet. action items: Dmitri PR for router, Emma figma copy update, Carla a11y checklist, Ben small mock for collapse behavior. i'll schedule a 30m sync if any blockers. :calendar:
